non_functional_requirements.name: DIP Response Time — Automated Path
non_functional_requirements.description: The Decision in Principle (DIP) must be issued within 15 minutes of the customer submitting their income and employment details on the automated processing path. This includes the soft credit check round-trip to the credit bureau (via SVC-012 event pair EVT-022/EVT-023), affordability assessment computation, and DIP document generation.
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: End-to-end latency from POST /mortgage-applications/{id}/dip request received by SVC-002 to DIPIssued event published (EVT-021). Measured via distributed trace span in SVC-111 (Audit & Logging).
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Customer expectation set by digital-first lenders (Habito, Molo) offering instant DIP. Competitive parity requirement. Supports customer journey continuity — estate agents expect same-day DIP.
non_functional_requirements.breach_action: Alert SVC-002 on-call. Automated DIP degraded to manual review queue (PER-055). Customer notified of delay within 30 minutes.

non_functional_requirements.name: Full Application Decision SLA
non_functional_requirements.description: The full underwriting decision (approve / refer / decline) must be communicated to the customer within 5 business days of receipt of a complete application pack (all required documents uploaded and verified).
non_functional_requirements.target: < 5 business days (P90) from complete application pack receipt to MortgageUnderwritingCompleted event (EVT-026)
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Business day counter starts when SVC-002 marks application as 'documents_complete'. Timer stops when EVT-026 is published. Monitored in the underwriting workflow SLA dashboard.
non_functional_requirements.regulatory_basis: MCOB 11 — lender must make a lending decision within a reasonable timeframe. FCA supervisory expectation: 5 business days is the stated target in MCOB guidance.
non_functional_requirements.breach_action: Automated SLA breach alert to underwriting team manager. Customer proactively notified with revised estimate.

non_functional_requirements.name: Affordability Pre-Check Response Time
non_functional_requirements.description: The affordability pre-check at PH-009 (Mortgage Enquiry) must return an indicative result within 2 minutes. No external API calls required — computed locally by SVC-002 affordability engine.
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Latency from affordability pre-check request to response payload at SVC-002 API gateway.

non_functional_requirements.name: Mortgage Service Availability
non_functional_requirements.description: SVC-002 (Mortgage Service) must maintain 99.95% availability measured monthly. This equates to a maximum of approximately 21.9 minutes of unplanned downtime per month. Planned maintenance windows must be outside of the business hours peak window (08:00–20:00 Monday–Saturday UK time).
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Synthetic monitoring via uptime probes against POST /mortgage-applications and GET /mortgage-applications/{id} endpoints. Measured over rolling 30-day window. Reported in monthly SLA dashboard.
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Mortgage applications are time-sensitive (offer validity, chain dependencies). Downtime during business hours directly impacts customer outcomes and may constitute a Consumer Duty failing.
non_functional_requirements.maintenance_window: Sunday 02:00–06:00 UK time (maximum 4-hour window, 2 weeks notice minimum)

non_functional_requirements.name: MCOB Affordability — Stress Test Rate
non_functional_requirements.description: All affordability assessments (DIP and full application) must apply the FCA MCOB 11.6 prescribed stress test. The stress test must calculate whether the customer can afford payments if the mortgage rate increases to the higher of: (a) the initial rate plus 3 percentage points, or (b) a floor rate published by the PRA (currently 7%). This must be applied to every AffordabilityAssessment record (ENT-013).
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% of AffordabilityAssessment records must have stress_test_rate >= max(initial_rate + 3%, 7%)
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Data quality check on ENT-013 stress_test_rate field at time of creation. Automated validation rule in SVC-002 affordability engine. Exception report reviewed quarterly by Head of Mortgages.
non_functional_requirements.regulatory_basis: FCA MCOB 11.6.5 — affordability assessment must include a stressed scenario
non_functional_requirements.breach_action: Any application with an AffordabilityAssessment missing or with below-floor stress_test_rate is blocked from proceeding to offer stage. Compliance team notified immediately.

non_functional_requirements.name: FCA Mortgage Conduct Rules — MCOB Full Compliance
non_functional_requirements.description: All aspects of the mortgage journey must comply with FCA MCOB (Mortgages and Home Finance: Conduct of Business sourcebook). Key obligations: ESIS pre-application illustration, affordability assessment, responsible lending checks, binding offer with reflection period, annual statements to mortgage borrowers.
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: MCOB compliance checklist embedded in underwriting workflow. Quarterly MCOB compliance review by Compliance team. FCA GABRIEL returns (mortgage statistics) submitted annually.
non_functional_requirements.owner: Compliance (CAP-005) — monitored by SVC-014 and SVC-002

non_functional_requirements.name: PRA LTI Cap Compliance
non_functional_requirements.description: The bank must ensure that no more than 15% of new residential mortgage lending in any quarter exceeds a loan-to-income (LTI) ratio of 4.5x. SVC-002 must track LTI ratios for all approved applications and produce a quarterly LTI distribution report for the PRA.
non_functional_requirements.target: ≤ 15% of quarterly new lending approvals with LTI > 4.5x
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: SVC-002 tracks LTI ratio on each MortgageApplication (ENT-012). Quarterly aggregate report produced for PRA submission.
non_functional_requirements.regulatory_basis: PRA Policy Statement PS11/13 — LTI flow limit; Financial Policy Committee Recommendation

non_functional_requirements.name: MCOB Binding Offer — 7-Day Reflection Period
non_functional_requirements.description: The mortgage offer must include a mandatory 7-day reflection period from the date of receipt by the customer. The bank must not execute the mortgage during this period unless the customer waives the reflection period in writing (which they may only do in specific circumstances under MCOB 6.7).
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% of mortgage offers with a 7-day reflection period enforced
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: SVC-002 enforces: customer_accepted date must be >= offer_date + 7 days unless explicit waiver recorded. Automated validation at MortgageOfferAccepted (EVT-028).
non_functional_requirements.regulatory_basis: FCA MCOB 6.7 — binding offer and reflection period

non_functional_requirements.name: Income Document Handling — PII Classification
non_functional_requirements.description: Income documents (payslips, P60, bank statements) are classified as PII — Sensitive Financial. Documents must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Access is restricted to PER-055 (Mortgage Underwriter) and PER-051 (Credit Analyst) during the underwriting phase. Documents must be retained for 7 years post-completion (MCOB record-keeping requirement) then securely deleted.
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% of income documents encrypted at rest and in transit. Access log maintained for all document views.
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Infrastructure compliance scan weekly. Access log audit monthly by Information Security.

non_functional_requirements.name: LTV Ratio Accuracy
non_functional_requirements.description: The LTV ratio stored on MortgageApplication (ENT-012) must always be derived as: loan_amount / min(purchase_price, valuation_amount) × 100. After PH-012 (Valuation), if the valuation_amount differs from purchase_price, the LTV must be recalculated using the lower value. The recalculated LTV is used for underwriting and product eligibility checks.
non_functional_requirements.target: ltv_ratio must be accurate to 2 decimal places. Post-valuation recalculation must occur within 30 minutes of EVT-025 (ValuationCompleted) being received.
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Automated reconciliation check on ENT-012 ltv_ratio vs. computed value. Alert on any discrepancy > 0.01%.

non_functional_requirements.name: Concurrent Application Throughput
non_functional_requirements.description: SVC-002 must support up to 500 concurrent mortgage application sessions without performance degradation. Peak load expected during January and spring (traditional property purchase seasons). Credit check event processing must not bottleneck at the SVC-102 event bus.
non_functional_requirements.target: 500 concurrent sessions at P95 < 15 minutes DIP response time
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: Load test quarterly against staging environment. Production throughput monitored via SVC-111 metrics dashboard.

non_functional_requirements.name: MCOB Record-Keeping — 7-Year Retention
non_functional_requirements.description: All mortgage application records, affordability assessments, valuation reports, underwriting decisions, and mortgage offers must be retained for a minimum of 7 years from completion or from the date the application was declined/withdrawn. Records must be stored in the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111).
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% of ENT-012, ENT-013, ENT-014, ENT-015, ENT-016 records retained for 7 years in SVC-111 WORM store
non_functional_requirements.measurement_method: SVC-111 retention policy enforcement. Annual data retention audit.
non_functional_requirements.regulatory_basis: FCA MCOB 11.4.22 — record-keeping obligations for mortgage lenders
